summary: Signup (Welcome) Challenge end-to-end tested. Backend: 13/14 of my public-URL API tests passed plus the agent's 12 isolated tests (12/12). Frontend (390x844 mobile player flow plus 1920 desktop admin): almost all requested flows work. Intro content is correct (WELCOME CHALLENGE, £50 GIVEAWAY, Number Sequence, 3/3/45s, how-to-play). Demo works: PRACTICE MODE badge shows, a practice time is shown and remaining attempts stay at 3. Real attempt 1 works: 3s countdown, the timer counts down, then the result screen shows 'ATTEMPT 1 OF 3 / ATTEMPT COMPLETED! / 1.682s / best / remaining 2'. The per-attempt scorecard is a blob PNG with Save (downloads prize-league-attempt-1-story.png), WhatsApp (opens a new tab) and Instagram (desktop downloads the image and shows the help text). Every attempt gets a different random board. Refreshing mid-attempt marks that attempt ABANDONED and remaining drops to 1. The X/leave dialog shows the exact text; Continue keeps progress; Leave with 0 completed attempts closes and the challenge never comes back; Leave with 1 completed attempt shows the partial final scorecard. Completing all attempts shows SEE FINAL SCORECARD, and the final scorecard has every button, both PNG downloads and Finish, after which a reload does not show it again. The international user is blocked from real play (reason message shown) and the demo works. player1 and the super admin never see the popup. The admin page works: toggle, list, game select (only number_sequence and colour_match enabled), Preview full screen (badge, real disabled, X closes), Preview scorecard, Participants (rank, best time, history expand), Analytics cards, Audit, and Publish without rules shows the error toast. A normal admin gets 403 on every /api/admin/signup-challenge/* endpoint. Regression smoke passed for home, /world, login and the /admin dashboard. Found 1 critical score-integrity issue and 1 functional bug (X on the partial scorecard).

critical.issue: Cash-prize score can be forged. The score is the client-reported duration_ms, with only an upper bound (<= server play time + 1.5s) and no lower bound. tap_ms is optional, so with tap_ms=[] the timing check is skipped. Reproduced: start an attempt, wait 4s, submit taps 1..20 with tap_ms=[] and duration_ms=100. The server stored status=completed, score=100 (0.100s), verified=True, and that would rank #1 for the £50 prize. Even when stamps are sent, the only check is >=60ms per tap, so 1.2s for 20 taps is accepted (a real human needs about 5-10s). Fix: require len(tap_ms)==len(taps)==target; reject when duration_ms < (server_play_ms - tolerance, e.g. 2-3s); raise the minimum per-tap interval (e.g. >=120-150ms) or set a sane minimum total time; optionally flag outliers for manual review.

minor.issue: Returns 404 'No signup challenge available' on a second forfeit (participation already dismissed). This surfaces in the UI as an error toast, see frontend bug.

Any /me call while an attempt is in_progress abandons it (by design: refresh = lost attempt). Side effect: opening the site in a second tab or device kills the attempt running in the first tab. Consider abandoning only when the same client session reloads, or document this.
demo_start increments demo_runs without limit; demo_max_runs is only enforced on the client. The event endpoint has no rate limit, so analytics counts can be inflated.

ui_bugs.issue: After 'Leave Challenge' with at least one completed attempt, the partial final scorecard shows. Pressing the X there (instead of FINISH) opens the 'Leave Signup Challenge?' dialog again. Confirming then calls /forfeit, which returns 404, shows the toast 'No signup challenge available', and the screen stays open. Fix: in closeClick, if partial is true or status is 'forfeited', call onClose()/finish() directly.

After the intl welcome tour is skipped, the challenge does not appear until the user navigates or reloads. The gate reads the localStorage tour flag only at render time, and nothing re-renders it when the tour is dismissed. Listen to a tour-done event or state.

integration_issues.issue: The wa.me redirect to api.whatsapp.com/send produced %EF%BF%BD (U+FFFD) in place of the 🏆 ⏱️ 💷 emojis. This is a known wa.me redirect emoji-mangling issue. Use https://api.whatsapp.com/send?text= directly and re-verify on a real device.

issues: Sonner toasts (e.g. 'Scorecard saved') appear at top-center and cover the X close button for a few seconds
Final scorecard 2-column buttons wrap to 2 lines at 390px ('Share to WhatsApp', 'Copy Challenge Link'); consider 1 column or shorter labels
Story scorecard PNG leaves the lower ~40% empty; centre the content vertically or add branding/QR
International users still see '3 TOTAL / 3 REMAINING' attempts even though they cannot play real; consider hiding those or showing 'Practice only'
Starts/Closes/Eligible-from fields and the analytics From/To filters use the native browser datetime picker instead of the shadcn calendar
The default selected challenge is the most recently created one (the archived 'TEST_ no rules'), not the published one
The Participants 'ATTEMPTS' column shows attempts_finished/attempts_used (e.g. 1/1), which reads like 'complete'; show finished/allowed (1/3)

action_items: CRITICAL: harden scoring in _score(). Require tap_ms for every tap, enforce a lower bound against server elapsed time, and set a realistic minimum per-tap interval and total time. Currently a 0.100s fake score is accepted as verified.
Fix X on the partial (forfeited) final scorecard: close directly instead of reopening the leave dialog / calling forfeit again.
Switch the WhatsApp share URL to api.whatsapp.com/send?text= to avoid broken emojis.
Make the gate re-check when the intl tour is skipped or finished.
Minor: default the admin selection to the published challenge; show attempts as finished/allowed; use the shadcn date picker; stop toasts from overlapping the X; split the 783-line routes file.
critical_code_review_comments: _score trusts client duration_ms (min 100ms) and skips the timing check when tap_ms is empty. This is the main integrity hole for a cash prize.
_rank_key ignores its tie argument (fine for now, only earliest_finish exists).
forfeit(): 'terminal' is computed from the stale part status read before _refresh_participation, so a participation that just completed via refresh could be marked forfeited. This is an edge case.
The gate fetches /me only once per readyKey, so a flag/challenge published later is not picked up until reload (acceptable).

rca of the issue: Score forgery: in _score(), duration = body.duration_ms if <= play_ms+1500, and only max(100, ...) is applied, so there is no lower bound. The stamps check runs only when tap_ms is non-empty. Repro: start an attempt, sleep 4s, POST submit {taps:[1..20], tap_ms:[], duration_ms:100, finished:true}; the result is completed with score 100. Partial-scorecard X: closeClick checks only status==='completed'; after forfeit the status is 'forfeited', so setLeave(true) runs, then confirmLeave runs, then /forfeit runs, but _my_participation filters dismissed_at=None, so it returns 404 and an error toast.
